description: This Kotlin source file defines the PlayerFragment class, a UI component that manages media playback using ExoPlayer within an Android app. It handles player initialization, release, key events for remote control, and lifecycle management, specifically tailored for a TV or media-rich application.

classes.name: PlayerFragment
classes.description: A fragment that manages media playback using ExoPlayer, handles user input for TV remote controls, and manages lifecycle events for resource management.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes UI components, and sets up key listeners for remote control.

methods.name: buildMediaItem
methods.description: Constructs a MediaItem object based on the media URL and content type.

methods.name: initializePlayer
methods.description: Initializes the ExoPlayer instance and prepares it with media content.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method; initializes the player if API level >= 24.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Brings UI to front and initializes the player if API level < 24.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases the player if API level < 24.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Releases the player if API level >= 24.
